content.user_title: Refresh SEO Content With Current Signals
content.value_statement: Older SEO pages lose relevance when statistics, examples, dates, and terminology become stale. This skill turns existing content into a prioritized refresh plan.
actual_capabilities: Identifies dated statistics, years, examples, terminology, and seasonal references in supplied content.
Ranks refresh work by impact signals such as ranking loss, traffic decline, and stale information.
Suggests new sections, FAQ additions, schema date updates, and internal link opportunities.
Creates per-page checklists and publishing calendar inputs for content teams.
Recommends freshness tactics for WordPress and static site workflows.
limitations: Does not verify facts without current source material or web access.
Does not update pages directly in a CMS.
Requires existing content, metrics, or notes to make precise recommendations.
Does not replace expert review for regulated or high-risk topics.

use_cases.title: Audit Declining Blog Posts
use_cases.description: Review older articles for stale data, dated examples, and missing recent developments before assigning updates.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Ranking Recovery Work
use_cases.description: Turn ranking loss, traffic decline, and stale content signals into a clear refresh queue.

use_cases.title: Prepare Writer Refresh Briefs
use_cases.description: Create focused update checklists that tell writers which sections, facts, and metadata need revision.

prompt_templates.title: Find Stale Elements
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this existing SEO page. Identify stale statistics, dates, examples, terminology, and seasonal references. Return a short refresh checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Refresh Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Standard update planning for one article.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this article, its target keyword, and the last updated date. Create a priority rating and recommended refresh actions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Freshness Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the page text and competitor notes provided. Identify missing current topics, weak examples, and sections that need expansion.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Portfolio Refresh Queue
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these pages with traffic, ranking, and last updated data. Group them by refresh priority and recommend publishing calendar actions.

output_examples.input: A 2023 buying guide with declining traffic and several old statistics.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a high-priority refresh plan with updated data needs, new comparison sections, and revised metadata recommendations.

output_examples.input: A set of blog URLs with ranking drops, last updated dates, and topic notes.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a refresh queue that separates urgent recovery pages from lower-priority maintenance updates.

output_examples.input: An evergreen article that has outdated examples and missing recent industry changes.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies replacement examples, recommends new FAQ questions, and suggests internal links to newer supporting pages.

best_practices: Provide the full page text, target keyword, last updated date, and available performance signals.
Include current source material when asking for statistic or example updates.
Use the recommendations as an editorial brief, then verify facts before publishing.
anti_patterns: Asking for current facts without providing sources or allowing research.
Changing dates only without adding meaningful content value.
Using the same refresh plan for every page regardless of search intent.

faq.question: What content does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews existing SEO pages, blog posts, guides, and editorial briefs for freshness problems.

faq.question: Can it verify current statistics?
faq.answer: It can flag stale statistics, but it needs current source material or web research to verify replacements.

faq.question: Does it update my website directly?
faq.answer: No. It creates recommendations, checklists, and planning outputs for your editing workflow.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How does it choose refresh priorities?
faq.answer: It considers stale information, ranking loss, traffic decline, seasonality, and missing recent developments.

faq.question: Is this useful for new content?
faq.answer: It is most useful for existing content, but its checklist can guide freshness planning for new pages.
